categories.title: We check what actually matters
categories.subtitle: Poor performance, broken SEO, and missing compliance cost you visitors, revenue, and credibility every day your site stays unfixed.

performance.title: Performance & Speed
performance.description: Slow pages lose visitors before they even load. Google ranks them lower too. We measure the same things Google does when deciding where your site appears.

seo.title: SEO
seo.description: If search engines can't read your pages properly, customers won't find you. We check whether Google can discover, understand, and rank your site.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Since June 2025, most EU businesses are legally required to have accessible websites. We check if yours meets the requirements.

legal.title: Trust & Compliance
legal.description: Missing cookie consent, no privacy policy, tracking before user approval. This can potentially lead to fines.

security.title: Security
security.description: Outdated software and missing security headers make your site an easy target. Most of these issues are invisible until something breaks.

standards.title: Website Quality
standards.description: Broken links, HTML errors, poor heading structure, and outdated code. These signal to visitors that your business doesn't invest in its online presence.

reportPreview.title: A full breakdown of what needs attention
reportPreview.subtitle: You get a scored breakdown of your site with specific issues, why they matter to your business, and what needs to change.

compliance.title: The EU Accessibility Act is law
compliance.description: Since June 2025, most businesses above micro-enterprise size must meet EU accessibility requirements. Non-compliance means fines up to SEK 10M in Sweden. Most Swedish businesses don't know this applies to them yet.

stat1.label: Maximum fine in Sweden for non-compliance

stat2.label: Required standard under the EU Accessibility Act

stat3.label: Employees or annual turnover threshold for enforcement

gdpr.title: Cookie compliance is not optional
gdpr.description: Your cookie banner needs an equally prominent reject button. Loading analytics before consent is a direct GDPR violation. IMY has been issuing formal warnings to Swedish businesses since April 2025.

stat1.label: Maximum GDPR fine, whichever is higher

stat2.label: Issued formal reprimands to Swedish companies in April 2025

stat3.label: Rejecting cookies must be as easy as accepting them

faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.subtitle: What you need to know before scanning.

items.question: Is this really free?
items.answer: Yes. No credit card, no hidden costs. But if the results are rough, don't be surprised if we offer to help.

items.question: What happens with my email?
items.answer: We use it to send your report and occasionally follow up with relevant offers. We never share it with third parties.

items.question: How long does the scan take?
items.answer: About 60 seconds. We run automated checks against your site covering all six categories in real time.

items.question: What does the report include?
items.answer: A score for each of the six categories, a list of every issue we found, and what to do about each one.

items.question: Who is Vivotiv?
items.answer: A Swedish company that helps businesses modernize their websites. We built this scan to show site owners exactly what they're missing.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Vivotiv ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use vivotiv.com and vivotiv.se (the "Service").

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.name: Vivotiv
controller.contact: If you have questions about how we handle your personal data, contact us at that address.

leadData.title: Scan submissions
leadData.description: When you submit a website scan, we collect your email address and the website URL you enter. This data is stored in our database so we can process the scan and send you the results.

analytics.title: Analytics data
analytics.description: If you consent to analytics cookies, we collect anonymized usage data including page views, session duration, device and browser type, and country-level location. This data is collected through PostHog and is only processed after you grant consent via the cookie banner.

errorMonitoring.title: Error and performance data
errorMonitoring.description: We use Sentry to monitor errors and application stability. When an error occurs, Sentry collects error messages, stack traces, browser and operating system metadata, and request URLs. Sentry does not set cookies. This data is processed based on our legitimate interest in maintaining a reliable service.

scan.purpose: Processing website scans and delivering results

followUp.purpose: Occasional follow-up communication about our services

analytics.purpose: Analyzing website usage to improve the service

processors.title: 4. Data Processors (Sub-processors)
processors.intro: We share data with the following third-party processors to operate the Service:

transfers.title: 5. International Data Transfers
transfers.description: Some of our processors (Vercel, Sentry, Cloudflare) operate in the United States. Where personal data is transferred outside the EU/EEA, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission to ensure adequate protection. We have Data Processing Agreements in place with all processors that handle personal data.

error.title: Scan not found

scanResults.scoringExplanation: Each category is scored from 0 to 100. Most categories run a fixed set of checks and calculate a weighted average. The overall score is a weighted average across all six categories.
scanResults.scoringAccessibility: Accessibility scoring works differently. Instead of checking a fixed list, we scan your page for actual violations. The score starts at 100 and deducts points per violation based on severity: critical issues deduct the most, minor issues the least. This means you may see fewer items listed under accessibility, but each one has a direct impact on the score.
